Name: Industrial Furnace  - Unofficial 1.6 Update
Author: wind0nd
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
An unofficial Stardew Valley 1.6 compatibility update of [b]Industrial Furnace[/b], originally created by [b]Traktori[/b]
Build a large furnace through Robin’s carpenter shop and smelt multiple ores at once.
This release updates the original mod for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.x. Building, smelting, and receiving outputs have been tested successfully.
[b]This is a community testing release. Please back up your saves before installing.[/b] Multiplayer, split-screen, multiple furnaces, old-save migration, custom items, and processing-state persistence after fully exiting and reloading the game have not yet been fully verified.
This update is unofficial and is not endorsed by the original author.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.5.2 or later.[/*]
[*]Back up your save files.[/*]
[*]If you have an older version of Industrial Furnace installed, remove its mod folder first.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded archive and place the 
[code]IndustrialFurnace[/code] folder inside your game’s 
[code]Mods[/code] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Visit Robin’s carpenter shop to build the Industrial Furnace.[/*]
[/list][b]Do not install the original mod and this unofficial update together.[/b] They use the same mod ID.
If you encounter a building or texture issue, enter
[code]if_check[/code]in the SMAPI console and include its output with your bug report, along with your full SMAPI log and reproduction steps.
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]A large furnace available to build through Robin’s carpenter shop.[/*]
[*]Smelts multiple ores at once.[/*]
[*]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.x.[/*]
[*]Includes the manually triggered 
[code]if_check[/code] diagnostic command for troubleshooting.[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility notes:[/b] Support for all custom ores and items is not guaranteed. Automate integration has not been verified for this release.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] — tested on version [b]1.6.15[/b].[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/b] — tested on version [b]4.5.2[/b].[/*]
[/list]The original Industrial Furnace mod does [b]not[/b] need to be installed separately.
Later game and SMAPI versions have not yet been verified.

Huge thanks to [b]Traktori [/b] for creating the original Industrial Furnace mod and sharing its source code under the MIT License.
